data.title: Four products built by the Cross Tech Edu team.
data.lead: From driving theory prep to finding event photos with a selfie and caring for a virtual tree, our own team designed and built each of these.
data.sub: Open a product for the details. If you need something similar, tell us about it.

rate.label: Status
rate.note: GPLX is on the App Store, FamHub and Plant Trees are coming soon, and FaceFind is in a pilot with its first event organizers.

data.title: GPLX, FamHub, FaceFind and Plant Trees
data.intro: Each card opens the product's own page. FamHub's page is in English; the other three are in Vietnamese for now.

items.name: GPLX
items.body: 600 questions across 15 license classes from A1 to DE, timed mock tests, road signs and memory tips. Free, with no ads.

items.name: FamHub
items.tagline: Know your kids got there safely
items.body: Parents get an alert when a child reaches school or leaves home, see live location when the child shares it, and keep daily to-dos on track together.

items.name: FaceFind
items.tagline: Find event photos with a selfie
items.body: Organizers paste a Google Drive folder link and share a QR code. Guests take a selfie, then view and download the photos they appear in, with no app to install.

items.name: Plant Trees
items.tagline: Care for a virtual tree, unwind for a few minutes
items.body: Water it, feed it, pick off the bugs and watch a virtual tree grow through 6 stages, with nature sounds in the background. No sign-in needed.

data.title: Need an app like one of these?
data.body: Send us your idea, target timeline and expected budget. Cross Tech Edu will reply with a concrete scope and price within 48 hours.
data.zalo_hint: Scan the QR code with the Zalo app, or tap to open the chat.
